work_experience.description: Performed manual and automated testing on HRM systems, identifying and reporting bugs. Designed and executed functional and regression test cases based on requirements. Used Katalon Studio for automation; participated in agile ceremonies and QA planning.

projects.name: Automated QA Suite for Plant Nursery Web App
projects.description: End-to-end automated QA suite for a plant nursery web app, validating UI and API features like categories, sales, and inventory. Role: Cucumber Step Definitions, API & UI Automation, Data Seeding Hooks, Page Object Model Implementation

projects.name: First Light Villas Reservation Management System
projects.description: A comprehensive web platform that automates villa and room reservations, manages real-time availability, handles secure online payments, generates reports, and improves overall booking efficiency for both customers and administrators. Role: Auth & Access Control, Villa/Room & Booking Management, Payment & Refunds, Report Handling, Playwright Automation Suite

projects.name: Track Master Smart Camera Bag
projects.description: An IoT-based camera bag designed to improve equipment safety using GPS tracking, automated locking, and environmental monitoring. Role: Location Tracking System using GSM Module

projects.name: Vehicle Hub Car Rental Management System
projects.description: A car rental system that automates reservations, tracks real-time availability, manages billing, and provides analytics and admin tools. Role: Reporting, Insights & Payment Gateway Modules
